name: Whitewater
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Whitewater, WI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Whitewater, Wisconsin for 2026: the Parade of Lights, Christmas at Cravath, Santa visits, a swim and live reindeer.
lede: Whitewater pairs a downtown Parade of Lights with the Christmas at Cravath display at the lakefront, then adds Santa breakfast, cookies, a swim with Santa and a visit from real reindeer.
celebrates: The City of Whitewater Parks and Recreation Department runs most of the season. The Parade of Lights travels from downtown to Cravath Lakefront Park, where the Christmas at Cravath light display is switched on, according to the city. The department then schedules Santa programs across December: a breakfast for dinner, decorating cookies with milk, a swim at the Aquatic and Fitness Center and a reindeer evening at the park. Discover Whitewater, the local tourism site, lists the lights and parade, and the programs mostly run on weeknights, so families can plan around school.
lastyear: Gazette Xtra reported that Whitewater held its Holiday Market and Parade of Lights on Friday, December 5, 2025, from 5 to 8 pm at Cravath Lakefront Park. The city's parks department described the same pairing for this year, with the lakefront lights switched on at the end of the parade.
facts: Cravath Lakefront Park is at 341 South Fremont Street in downtown Whitewater, the city says, and it hosts the light display and several Santa programs. The Whitewater Aquatic and Fitness Center runs its Swim with Santa as a pool event, which makes it one of the few indoor Santa swims on this guide. The city names the chamber contact for parade information as 262-473-4005.
trains: Whitewater does not have a Christmas train. The East Troy Railroad Museum, about a half hour away by car, runs daytime and evening Christmas trains and the free Santa Parade Train, and our museum guide lists it. Whitewater families can pair a lakefront lights night with a train weekend.
train_links: Christmas trains and the Santa Parade Train, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: A downtown parade that ends at Cravath Lakefront Park.
A free light display at the lakefront park, up into early January.
Santa joins a pancake style dinner with online registration.
Families decorate cookies at the lakefront park building, with milk sponsored by Katzman Family Farms.
A pool event at the Aquatic and Fitness Center.
Live reindeer visit the park, with free viewing.
kidfact: Whitewater's lakefront park lights up after the parade, and real reindeer visit it in December.
faq: Whitewater celebrates with a downtown Parade of Lights that ends at Cravath Lakefront Park, where the Christmas at Cravath light display is switched on. City Parks and Recreation then runs Santa programs through December, including cookies, a swim and a reindeer visit.
Yes. The light display at Cravath Lakefront Park is free to visit, and it stays up into early January, according to Discover Whitewater and the city.
Can kids swim with Santa in Whitewater?
Yes. The Aquatic and Fitness Center holds a Swim with Santa for a small per-swimmer fee, with registration online or in person at the center.
Do you need to register for Santa events in Whitewater?
Some events do. The city encourages registration for the cookie evening and requires online registration for breakfast for dinner. The parade, lights and reindeer viewing are open to everyone.
Are there real reindeer in Whitewater?
Yes. A reindeer company brings live reindeer to Cravath Lakefront Park for an evening. Viewing is free, and the company sells photos.
